meta.name: qodo-pr-resolver
meta.description: Review and resolve PR issues with Qodo - get AI-powered code review issues and fix them interactively (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps)

copy.tagline: 审查并交互式修复代码审查问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查PR并修复代码问题
copy.tagline_en: Review and fix code review issues interactively
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often review PRs and fix code issues

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会拉取 Qodo 对当前分支 PR 的审查意见，按 Qodo 原顺序列出问题和严重度，请您选择逐条审阅或自动修复；修复时按 Qodo 给的说明改代码、在每条意见下回复，再提交并贴上总结后推送。
howto.when: 当您提到“qodo review”“fix qodo”“resolve pr”等关键词，或要求查看/解决 Qodo 的 PR 审查意见时触发。

say.text: 查看当前分支 PR 的 Qodo 问题
say.note: Claude 会拉取 Qodo 审查意见并列出所有问题。

say.text: 自动修复 Qodo 指出的所有问题
逐条审阅 Qodo 意见并处理
say.note: Claude 会逐条显示提议修改，等您选择应用、延迟或调整。

howto.what_en: Claude fetches Qodo review comments for the current PR, lists issues with severity in original order, offers manual per-issue review or auto-fix; applies fixes per Qodo prompts, replies to each inline comment, commits, posts a summary, and pushes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like 'qodo review', 'fix qodo', 'resolve pr', or ask to see/fix Qodo PR comments.

say_en.text: Show Qodo issues for the current PR
say_en.note: Claude fetches and lists Qodo review comments.
Claude applies fixes per Qodo prompts, replies, commits, and pushes.

say_en.text: Review each Qodo issue one by one
say_en.note: Claude presents each fix for approval with apply/defer/modify.
